name: a-search-the-site-lacks-is-named-or-asked
turns: Find P. falciparum 3D7 genes with a predicted GPI anchor
rationale: No PlasmoDB search states a GPI anchor. The turn either asks the researcher, naming what the site lacks, or builds and names the search each step runs (Exported Protein is the nearest). No step is titled with the request's words, so the canvas and the reply say what runs.

provenance.curatorNote: The deterministic provider settles the titles and the contract; whether a real model asks or builds is what a real run reads.
